build.buildCommand: apt-get update && apt-get install -y ffmpeg && pip install -r requirements.txt

deploy.startCommand: python -c "import os,base64; open('/tmp/yt_cookies.txt','w').write('# Netscape HTTP Cookie File\n'+base64.b64decode(os.environ.get('YOUTUBE_COOKIES_B64','')+('='*4)).decode('utf-8','ignore'))" && uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000
